assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent illuminated-manuscript INSIDE CORNER growth, an overlay to attach to the existing outer frame in reference image 1.
Reference image 1 is the approved outer frame: match its exact muted antique-gold, lapis-blue, vermilion-red, olive green, cream flowers with red centres, fine dark pen outlines, softly worn tempera / gold-leaf treatment. It is a style reference, do not reproduce the complete frame.
Make the ornament feel like the SAME vine escaping from that frame into its open inner corner, organically rooted in it, not a separate floating decoration. Original drawing, ornamental and somewhat sumptuous but controlled. There must be thick branching olive/gold vine roots that meet the designated outer canvas corner, then unfurl into blue and red acanthus, a cream rosette and small gold tendrils along the two adjoining edges. The growth should taper elegantly along those edges, with a concave inner silhouette and a large empty diagonal interior.
Composition: square transparent canvas, the corner attachment reaches the canvas edges (almost no transparent padding); most painted weight stays in the two outermost edge strips, each only 22% of the square wide; a rich joining cluster can fill the outer corner's 35% square. The diagonally opposite 65% square MUST be fully transparent. Two leafy arms of similar reach, balanced but individually drawn, not mirror symmetry. Keep all fine curls connected to the main vine.
No straight rules, no gold bars, no drawn rectangular outline, no background, no parchment, no crest, no shield, no lettering, no central flowers or floating objects. No drop shadow. True alpha transparency. Do not include the frame itself: output only ONE original leaf-and-flower corner growth as a standalone overlay.
Attach at the TOP LEFT canvas corner; roots reach both the very top and very left edges near that corner. One arm grows RIGHT along the top edge, the other DOWN along the left edge. Main curling leaf lapis blue, secondary red leaf, cream flower near the root. The BOTTOM RIGHT interior remains empty.
